$comment: The rooms gate's per-rule ratchet (#1015, Wave 4). It may only ever go DOWN: a rule above its max fails `bun run lint:product`, a rule under it prints the number to lower it to, and a rule absent here is at ZERO. Each entry names what clears it. Re-measured on lane/1015-apps-b in Round NY; run `node scripts/lint-mobile-rooms.mjs` to re-measure. `back-literal`, `identity-tint`, `copy-title-case`, `error-detail` and `page-margin` reached zero and are gone from this file, which makes them unconditional (`error-detail` by the R-A-15 sweep; `page-margin` by R-NY-6, which named PhotoTile's chip inset as the kit's `tileChipInset` where the geometry lives instead of allowlisting it here, #1015).

screen-root.clearedBy: #1015 owner ruling — `PhotoLightbox`, the full-bleed viewer (stage ground, dismiss gesture, no header, band hidden), which none of the six rooms fits honestly. Round NY (R-NY-7) cleared the other 32: 22 by resolving one app-frame level, 10 by migration or by letting the frame read as the root.
